direction.fantasy: Summer baseball on broadcast TV: six ballparks, each a postcard with its own hour, sky and light.

references.source: generic reference: centre-field broadcast camera of a professional ballgame (any league, any season)
references.why: Mown turf stripes, terracotta infield clay, chalk lines and a warm broadcast film grade under one hard key

references.source: generic reference: mid-century travel postcards of ballparks at golden hour, night and indoors
references.why: One hour and one sky per venue, a visible horizon behind the stands and a single accent colour per park

references.source: generic reference: slow-motion footage of a wooden bat meeting a pitched ball
references.why: The contact frame: ash splinters leaving the barrel and a short white flash read as the moment of the swing
